name.zh: PBCube WR 三阶 (20 磁 球轴 + 磁悬浮 + UV)

note.zh: 官方新品发布会为 8 月 25 日，次日发布上新公告。
note.en: Official launch event on August 25, followed by the product announcement on August 26.

note.en: US retailer asking price observed on October 7, 2026; availability, shipping and tax depend on the seller, and this is not a Chinese launch price.

adjustment.zh: 8 档调节形成官方标示 512 种组合。
adjustment.en: 8-level systems yield the advertised 512 combinations.

highlights.zh: 超级傲龙联名创作路线，定制蓝色内核、碳纤维轴心。
highlights.en: Super AoLong collaboration platform with blue internals and a carbon-fiber core.

highlights.zh: 本版本配置：磁悬浮弹力、角轴/球轴磁力定位、UV 亮面。
highlights.en: This version: MagLev elasticity, corner/core magnetic guidance, UV gloss finish.

summary.zh: 以联名、轻量刚性轴心与精细调节为卖点。
summary.en: Emphasizes collaboration branding, a light rigid core and fine adjustment.

tradeoffs.zh: “纪录同款”属于产品定位，不保证零售个体等同选手定制手感。
tradeoffs.en: Record-edition branding does not guarantee the same feel as a player’s personally tuned unit.
